fileChanges: AirframeCore canonical project/state repository, ID allocator, validation, and focused tests.
AICockpit work-item create commands and bounded work-ID lookup command.
notes: This companion plan must be approved with PLAN-027-048 before EP-027 is drafted or implementation begins.
scope: Maintain canonical per-project counters for Epic, Sprint, Task, and Issue IDs.
Allocate an ID atomically as part of work-item creation; normal create commands must not require a caller-supplied ID.
Provide a bounded next-ID query that reads only allocator state and returns one candidate ID.
Retain explicit ID input only for controlled import or migration, with duplicate and counter-consistency validation.
Initialize counters safely for existing workspaces without reading generated Markdown, GitHub enumeration, or broad work-item collections during normal operation.
summary: Replace inferred work-item numbering and collection scans with canonical, atomic per-kind ID allocation and a bounded next-ID lookup.
title: Canonical Work Item ID Allocation
verificationCriteria: Tests cover sequential allocation, per-kind independence, duplicate explicit IDs, counter initialization, atomic create allocation, bounded lookup output, and no collection enumeration on normal allocation.
